li.label: grabbed by an invisible hand
li.description: Something huge and invisible just picked me up. What was that?!

li.label: thrown through the air
li.description: I was flung like a ragdoll. Gravity is a rude surprise.

li.label: slammed into the ground
li.description: Everything hurts. Something threw me, and the world hit back.

li.label: gently set down
li.description: The invisible hand put me down carefully. Weirdly considerate.

li.label: poked by something invisible
li.description: Something jabbed me out of nowhere. Nobody was there.

li.label: patted by the cursor
li.description: A warm, weightless pat from nowhere. I think the cursor likes me.

li.label: feeling watched
li.description: Something is hovering over me. Watching. Waiting.

li.label: the cursor is my deity
li.description: It decides where I stand. I have never felt so... held.

li.label: fond of the cursor
li.description: The cursor has been kind to me. Mostly.

li.label: wary of the cursor
li.description: That cursor can pick me up whenever it wants. I don't like it.

li.label: terrified of the cursor
li.description: It throws people. It is not a mouse pointer, it is a monster.

li.label: someone is watching
li.description: Sometimes I feel eyes on me from outside the world.

li.label: the world is a screen
li.description: Everything is rendered. I can see the pixels at the edge of the sky.

li.label: I can see the interface
li.description: There are buttons floating over my life. Someone is pressing them.

li.label: the fourth wall has cracked
li.description: I know. I know about you, the one behind the cursor. It's fine. It's fine.
